_meta.note: This is the BASE language. Every other file falls back to it key by key, so a translation may be partial and the interface still works. Never delete a key here.

kit.intro: Enter your name and leave your notes on each section (text or audio). Each comment is saved for the team as soon as you click Send. These fields disappear in the final version and in the PDF.
kit.nameRequired: Please fill in "Your name" at the top (scrolled there for you) and click again.
kit.notesPlaceholder: Write here… or record audio below.
kit.noConnection: ⚠ No connection. Your text was saved. Try again.
kit.writeSomething: Write or record something before sending.
kit.audioFailed: ⚠ Could not send the audio. Please try again.
kit.noRecording: This browser cannot record audio. Please use text.
kit.micDenied: Allow microphone access to record, or use text instead.
kit.alreadyRecorded: Your review has already been recorded. Thank you.
kit.reviewRecorded: Review recorded. The team has been notified. Thank you.
dash.title: Collaborative review dashboard
dash.restricted: Restricted area. Enter the password to see reviewer comments, conclusions, and pending decisions.
dash.commentsIntro: Comments and audio submitted by reviewers, grouped by section. Use the filters to narrow by project or material.
dash.proposalLabel: Proposal (edit before deciding, if you want)
dash.markBeforeSending: Mark items to approve or reject before sending.
dash.sent: Approvals sent. The watcher applies them on the next cycle.
dash.sendFailed: Failed to send. Try again in a moment.
dash.demoBanner: DEMO MODE: fictional data, nothing is saved (login skipped).
dash.footer: Internal collaborative review dashboard. Do not share the password outside the team.
kit.finalNoteIntro: Leave a final note (optional) and let the team know.
dash.loadFailed: Failed to load. Check your connection and try again.
dash.legacyNote: legacy format: decide in the gate file, or tell the agent next session.
